description: Finds every verse where a Hebrew or Greek word occurs, ignoring accents and cantillation (e.g. ἀγάπη, λόγος, חֶסֶד). Returns the source text and the translation side by side.

(Challoner), English), elberfelder_1905 (Elberfelder 1905, German), elberfelder_1871 (Elberfelder 1871, German), dnb30 (Bibelselskapet 1930, Norwegian Bokmål), erv (English Revised Version), finn (Finnish 1776), geneva (Geneva Bible, English), hcv (Haitian Creole Bible (1985)), he_modern (Modern Hebrew Bible (Delitzsch NT)), jps (JPS Tanakh 1917, English), kougo (Kougo-yaku 1954/55, Japanese), language.description: Language for names, notes and study content, and for the links to bible.flogvit.com: en (English), nb (Norwegian Bokmål), nn (Norwegian Nynorsk), sv (Swedish), fr (French), es (Spanish), fi (Finnish), de (German). Content missing in a language falls back to English. Default: en.

mapping.description: Verse numbering to give the verse references in: a mapping id from list_verse_mappings, e.g. "english_kj" (King James) or "dnb2024_nb", or a short name such as "kjv". Default: osnb, the site's own numbering.

offset.description: How many verses to skip, for the next page: pass the offset the previous answer names. Default: 0.

word.description: The word in Hebrew or Greek script, with or without accents and vowel points, e.g. "ἀγάπη" or "חסד".

name: search_original_word
title: Find a Hebrew or Greek word
